question: What is the meaning of list of materials in relation to product composition?
description: The list of materials in relation to product composition refers to the detailed breakdown of all the materials and substances that make up a product. This includes chemical substances, hazardous substances, and the nature of recycled content. The list is established using a threshold at the product level, meaning that all substances above the threshold are reported by name and identifier. The threshold value is set by the supplier and can be chosen among four levels: 10 ppm, 100 ppm, 0.1% or 1%. The product composition declaration is available publicly.
